title: Make Cord Clutter a Thing of the Past With This Powerful Wireless HDMI Streamer
summary: The Phoenix Home transmitter only has one HDMI input for the source video and the receiver only has one HDMI out for connecting to a TV or projector. I used three scenarios to test the Phoenix Home True 4K.
